data.title: Mastering Translations and Reflections
data.description: Practice applying precise translations and reflections to various geometric figures on the coordinate plane.

challenges.narration: A sticker is peeled and re-placed.
challenges.instruction: Translate the figure by (-3, 1). Drag each pink corner to its new position.
challenges.hint: Add (-3, 1) to every vertex: x → x + -3, y → y + 1.

challenges.narration: A logo flipped across a fold line.
challenges.instruction: Reflect the figure over the y-axis. Drag each pink corner to its mirror position.
challenges.hint: Reflecting over the y-axis flips the sign of x: (x, y) → (−x, y).

challenges.instruction: Reflect the figure over the line y = x. Drag each pink corner to its image.
challenges.hint: Reflecting over y = x swaps the coordinates: (x, y) → (y, x).
challenges.transformLabel: Reflection over the line y = x

challenges.narration: A shape and its mirror image in a calm pond.
challenges.instruction: Reflect the figure over the x-axis. Drag each pink corner to where it lands.
challenges.hint: Reflecting over the x-axis keeps x and flips the sign of y: (x, y) → (x, −y).
